title: Woman with Horse at Farm Fence, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white outdoor snapshot featuring a young woman standing near a wire fence line next to a pinto horse in a field. She is wearing classic 1940s casual attire, including high-waisted trousers and a short-sleeved blouse. A small house and leafy trees are visible in the background, capturing mid-20th-century rural American farm life.
